input: Pick a godparent for the new baby

gold.taskTitle: Choose a godparent for the new baby
gold.taskDescription: Select and confirm a suitable godparent for the user's new baby.

questions.title: Is this choice tied to a religious ceremony or tradition?
questions.description: Understand whether the godparent role is religious (e.g., baptism) or purely a meaningful personal/family designation.

questions.title: How many godparents are you planning to choose?
questions.description: Clarify whether the user wants one godparent, a godmother and godfather, or some other combination.

questions.title: Do you already have specific people in mind?
questions.description: Find out if the user has candidates in mind or needs help thinking through who to consider.

questions.title: Are you and your partner deciding this together?
questions.description: Determine whether this is a joint decision between co-parents or a solo choice, which affects the process.

questions.title: What qualities matter most to you in a godparent?
questions.description: Identify the values, traits, or practical qualities the user wants in a godparent, such as religious faith, emotional closeness, or financial stability.

questions.title: Is there a deadline, such as a baptism or naming ceremony date?
questions.description: Establish any time pressure so the plan can be properly paced.

questions.title: Have any potential candidates already been approached or told?
questions.description: Understand the current state of any conversations so advice on next steps is accurate.
